newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Prasidha details joint venture plans.
newsitem.headline: Prasidha details joint venture plans.

text.p: Indonesian commodity trading firm PT Prasidha Aneka Niaga said on Monday it planned two joint ventures with overseas firms in the commodities sector in the near future.

The company said in a statement that it planned to set up a joint venture with Itochu Corp to manufacture crumb rubber for export. Prasidha said it would own 51 percent of the venture, with Itochu controlling 49 percent.
It said also that it planned to set up a 50:50 joint venture with Burns, Philp and Co to source, process, grind, package, market and export pepper.
No further details of the ventures were given.
Also on Monday, Prasidha inaugurated a new coffee plant in near the East Java capital of Surabaya.

Prasidha Vice-President Director Jeffry Soedargo said in a speech at the opening of the plant in Sidoarjo, East Java, that the firm hoped to produce 3,600 tonnes of instant coffee and 2,400 tonnes of ground coffee annually.
Agriculture Minister Syarifuddin Baharsyah presided over the dispatch of the first two containers of instant coffee to be exported to Japan.

The plant is a joint venture between Prasidha, which owns 65 percent, Itochu of Japan 20 percent, local company PT Citra Buana Tunggal Prakasa 10 percent and Ueshima Coffee Company of Japan 5 percent.
